context: Positive momentum on all three indices with only a small retracement, no big one -- BankNIFTY held itself above 56500 -- so he reads BUYERS as possibly seated. SENSEX has its expiry on 24 Sep.
plan: THE FLAT BRANCH FLIPPED FROM 23 SEP: last night a flat open meant BUY, to hunt seated sellers. Tonight the seated side is BUYERS, so a flat open means SELL. Carrying yesterday's flat-open branch forward inverts it.
FLAT TO GAP DOWN -> SELL: identify selling-side setups to TARGET the buyers who may be seated after a rise that gave no big retracement.

OPEN ABOVE THE HIGHER POINT -> BUY. The buy branch is a LEVEL, not a gap size: above the prior high -- on NIFTY especially above 23500 -- buyers stay confident, will not cut, and leave no SLs to hunt.
A GAP UP THAT OPENS BELOW THE PRIOR HIGH IS NOT IN HIS PLAN. A computed GAP_UP verdict alone does not select the buy branch: check where the open sits against the prior high first.
